In this YouTube Short, we break down Machine Learning vs Deep Learning in under 60 seconds with a simple explanation. Machine Learning focuses on learning from structured data using algorithms to make predictions like spam filters, recommendations, and pricing models. Deep Learning goes a step further by using neural networks to learn patterns on its own, powering technologies like face recognition, voice assistants, self-driving cars, and generative AI. If you’re confused about the difference or planning to enter the AI field, this quick comparison will clear things up instantly. Perfect for beginners, students, and professionals exploring AI careers in 2026.
